From [node-unrar-js](https://github.com/YuJianrong/node-unrar.js) 2.0.2
(`esm/js/`): the UnRAR library compiled to WebAssembly (`unrar.js`,
`unrar.wasm`) and the `Extractor` base class. Licenses: `node-unrar-js.LICENSE`
(MIT, the wrapper) and `unrar.LICENSE` (UnRAR, freeware: may be used to handle
RAR archives without limitations). Only the source-map comments were removed.
